rush.note: odd-man rush; prior 0.70 (about 2.0x the odds) is a judgment call anchored above a measured floor: NHL shots within 6 s of a neutral/defensive-zone turnover score at 1.58x (+0.46 +/- 0.03, 20,223 shots, nhl_turnover_rush.py), and an odd-man rush is the subset of those where the defence is short

cross_ice.note: royal-road pass: passer and shooter on opposite sides of the road, both below the circle tops, shot within 0.5 s; prior measured on real games, about 2.5x the odds
cross_ice.prior_source: Big Data Cup 2021 women's NCAA/NWHL/Olympic events: 87 royal-road shots, 16 goals, of 2976 unblocked

block_note: blocked attempts score this fraction of their unblocked xG; 0.25 is a judgment call until fit_tagged.py measures it from goals tagged off a defender (h)
